segments.sn14.16:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dhātusova, bhikkhave, sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:1.4: Atītampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.
segments.sn14.16:2.1: “Anāgatampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandissanti samessanti.
segments.sn14.16:3.1: “Etarahipi kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:4.6: evameva kho, bhikkhave, dhātusova [sabbatthapi evameva dissati] sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:4.8: Atītampi kho addhānaṃ … pe … anāgatampi kho addhānaṃ … pe … etarahipi kho paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:5.3: Atītampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu.
segments.sn14.16:6.1: “Anāgatampi kho, bhikkhave, addhānaṃ … pe … etarahipi kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:7.6: evameva kho, bhikkhave, dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:7.8: Atītampi kho addhānaṃ … anāgatampi kho addhānaṃ … etarahipi kho paccuppannaṃ addhānaṃ dhātusova sattā saṃsandanti samenti.
segments.sn14.16:8.2: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –

lines: Chaṭṭhe gūtho gūthena saṃsandati sametīti samuddantare janapadantare cakkavāḷantare ṭhitopi vaṇṇenapi gandhenapi rasenapi nānattaṃ anupagacchanto saṃsandati sameti, ekasadisova hoti nirantaro.
Ayaṃ pana aniṭṭhaupamā hīnajjhāsayānaṃ hīnaajjhāsayassa sarikkhabhāvadassanatthaṃ āhaṭā, khīrādivisiṭṭhopamā kalyāṇajjhāsayānaṃ ajjhāsayassa sarikkhabhāvadassanatthaṃ.
Asaṃsaggena chijjatīti ekato ṭhānanisajjādīni akarontassa asaṃsaggena adassanena chijjati.
“Dhātuso saṃsandantī”ti idaṃ ajjhāsayato sarikkhatādassanaṃ, na kāyena missībhāvadassananti āha “samuddantare”tiādi.
Vanati bhajati sajjati tenāti vanaṃ, vanathoti ca kileso vuccatīti āha “vanatho jātoti kilesavanaṃ jātan”ti.
